sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Retail of Oversized Furniture and Home Decor

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law foundation with French civil law influence and customary law; unitary national legal system without sub-state tax distinction)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus)
Vanuatu–Australia Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) — information exchange only, no comprehensive DTAA
Vanuatu–New Zealand Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) — information exchange only
Foreign Investment Promotion Act [Cap. 246] registration regime for foreign-controlled enterprises

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; International Company Managers Act [Cap. 220]; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2022 (as amended); Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2021 made under the Companies Act [Cap. 191]; Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) directives on customer due diligence and beneficial ownership reporting.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of valid passport of each shareholder, director, and individual UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or national passport authority in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (primary for Apostille Convention origin states); Consular Legalization (for non-Hague origin states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or financial institution in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille / Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming account conduct and source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate or personal bank of the applicant
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank-certified signature plus Hague Apostille / Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation, registers, and UBO declaration of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry and registered agent of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Duly executed power of attorney appointing the VFSC-licensed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Grantor executed before a notary public in the place of execution

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, authorized signatories, and beneficial owners against the UN Security Council consolidated list, OFAC SDN list, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, and the domestic VFIU designated-persons and PEP list; enhanced due diligence mandatory for PEPs and persons in prominent public functions within 12 months of cessation; risk-based CDD per FATF Recommendations; ongoing transaction monitoring and 5-year record retention under the AML/CFT Act 2022.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: VFSC Company Registry (Vanuatu Financial Services Commission) — electronic name search and reservation lodged through VFSC-licensed registered agents under the International Company Managers Act [Cap. 220]; official portal: www.vfsc.vu.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the governing corporate language; names must be expressed in Latin script; French-language names are acceptable with accurate transliteration; the name must be visually and phonetically distinguishable from all existing registered names and reserved names; an International Company name must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Inc', or an approved abbreviation.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The licensed registered agent may file a written administrative objection with the VFSC Registrar within 14 days of a name refusal, supported by legal submissions; alternatively, the applicant may immediately file a fresh name reservation or apply for the relevant minister's written consent where the refusal is based on a sensitive token; after expiry of the reservation period the name reverts to the availability pool; an adverse final decision is subject to administrative-law remedies including judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A registered office in Vanuatu maintained by a VFSC-licensed registered agent is mandatory; physical business premises in Vanuatu are not required for a non-resident, remotely-operated online retailer; a virtual registered-office address for service of process is expressly accepted, and no local commercial substance or local directors are required for this non-licensed, tax-exempt International Company.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (<10% annualized probability) for a pure e-commerce IC with no local license; VFSC retains statutory power to conduct unannounced inspections under the AML/CFT regime upon suspicion of money laundering, sanctions exposure, or material reporting anomalies; probability rises to moderate if the entity becomes a payment-service intermediary or holds client funds.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1992 (Cap. 222), ss. 7-10 (incorporation, memorandum, articles, name), s. 14 (registered office), ss. 17-19 (directors and registers), s. 49 (tax exemption for international companies)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registry of International Companies
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association lodged with the Registrar of International Companies under the supervision of a VFSC-licensed registered agent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement; the Company may be incorporated with one share of no par value. No escrow or capital deposit is required by the International Companies Act 1992.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) That the Company allot and issue one ordinary share to the founding subscriber, whose subscription is hereby accepted in accordance with the Memorandum and Articles of Association; (2) That the registered office of the Company at the address maintained by the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, be and is hereby adopted; (3) That [Name] be and is hereby appointed sole Director, and [Name] be and is hereby appointed Secretary of the Company; (4) That the Director be and is hereby authorised to affix the common seal, open bank accounts, and execute all instruments necessary to finalise incorporation and commence lawful operations. Dated this day of , 20 , signed by the incorporator.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registry of International Companies via a VFSC-licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the licensed registered agent to conduct a name availability search against the VFSC corporate names database. Propose a name ending with an accepted suffix such as 'Limited' or 'Corporation' and submit the name reservation application to the Registry. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered entity and must not imply a prohibited or regulated activity.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name and intended business purpose
Identity particulars of the founding subscriber/shareholder
Signed engagement letter with the VFSC-licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for conflict, undesirability, or resemblance, submit an alternative name request or file a written appeal to the Registrar within 14 days of the refusal notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent in conjunction with the incorporator
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association in English in accordance with the International Companies Act 1992. The memorandum must state the company name, registered office clause, share structure, and objects; the articles govern share transfer, directors' powers, and meeting procedures. The subscriber must execute the governing documents, with signature attested by a witness or the registered agent.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association executed by the subscriber
Articles of Association
Consent of the registered agent to act, if required by the agent's engagement terms
Consent to act as director from each proposed director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC queries any constitutional provision as non-compliant, the subscriber may re-execute an amended Memorandum and Articles and resubmit them without a new fee within the Registry's specified correction window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Statutory Consents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation application through the registered agent's digital portal or in person at the VFSC counters in Port Vila. Include the executed Memorandum and Articles, the registered office consent confirming a physical address at the agent's premises in Port Vila, and the beneficial ownership declaration required under VFSC due diligence policy. The application must state that the company will not carry on business with Vanuatu resident persons unless licensed separately.
required_dossiers: Completed incorporation application form prescribed by VFSC
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Certified copies of passports of directors and shareholders
Proof of registered office address in Port Vila maintained by the licensed agent
Beneficial ownership and due diligence questionnaire
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a query or document deficiency notice, the registered agent may cure by filing supplementary declarations or corrected forms within 14 days; unresolved defects trigger a fresh filing with a new fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the statutory government registration fee of USD 300 (or the vatu equivalent per VFSC's published fee schedule) by bank transfer to the VFSC official account or via the online payment gateway. Retain the bank reference or payment receipt and instruct the agent to attach the proof of payment to the incorporation file to avoid processing delay.
required_dossiers: Payment voucher or wire transfer reference of USD 300
Incorporation application reference number issued by VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the payment is not matched to the application, submit the bank confirmation to VFSC Treasury and obtain a reconciliation letter to release the file for registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review of the application, constitutional documents, consents, and fee payment, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the official seal of VFSC and the date of registration. The company acquires legal personality and limited liability on that date. Verify that the certificate name, date, and company number match the approved reservation.
required_dossiers: Approved incorporation application
Filed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Statutory consents and payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains a typographical or legal discrepancy, submit the original certificate with a written correction request for re-issuance by the Registrar; corrections are ministerial and do not require re-filing fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting, Share Allotment, and Corporate Kit Delivery
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company directors and VFSC-licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first meeting of the board of directors or obtain a written resolution in lieu of a meeting. Adopt the pro-forma resolution allotting the subscriber's share, fixing the registered office, and appointing the director and secretary. Record the resolutions in the minute book, update the share register and register of directors, issue share certificates, and arrange for the common seal to be cut if required by the Articles.
required_dossiers: Signed first board resolution and minutes
Share register and register of directors and secretaries
Share certificates issued to the founding shareholder
Corporate seal (optional unless required by bank or counterparties)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an allotment, appointment, or sealing act is later found defective, the board may pass a ratifying resolution under the Articles' ratification clause and the registered agent will file the corrective record with VFSC where necessary.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - ISIC 4791 online retail of oversized furniture and home decor is not a licensable industrial activity under Vanuatu law. The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) remains the sole relevant authority for International Company compliance.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No operating licence required - statutory licence exemption applies to pure offshore e-commerce. The Certificate of Incorporation and, where bank onboarding requires it, a Certificate of Good Standing from VFSC are the operative instruments.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Energy and Environment, Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - no EIA registration, scoping opinion, or full Environmental Statement is triggered because the undertaking involves no manufacturing, extraction, or discharge-producing activity.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable. If a local warehousing facility is operated, general solid waste must be handled in accordance with the Waste Management Regulations 2004; no wastewater, VOC, or air emissions thresholds are engaged by retail warehousing and dispatch operations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No clearance required for a purely offshore e-commerce company without physical premises in Vanuatu. If a showroom or warehouse is leased locally: obtain a Fire Safety Certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Services, occupancy and structural load clearance from the Port Vila Municipal Council Building Inspectorate, workplace and OHS registration with the Labour Department (Ministry of Internal Affairs), and Customs import permits for inventory shipped into Vanuatu.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Government of Vanuatu; official portal: https://customsinlandrevenue.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) with no local taxable supplies is not issued a Tax Identification Number; the IC relies on its statutory exemption under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222) and is not required to register for tax. If the IC makes or intends to make taxable supplies in Vanuatu with a 12-month turnover exceeding VT 5,000,000, the foreign entity must apply to the DCIR for VAT registration on the prescribed form (VAT-100), submitting the certificate of incorporation, registered agent confirmation, registered office address, business description, projected turnover, and banking details. The DCIR then issues a VAT/TIN number. A non-resident IC may apply for voluntary VAT registration without a permanent establishment in Vanuatu if it demonstrably makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu or makes supplies that can be zero-rated as exports.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu does not operate a check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election regime because there is no corporate income tax. Available elections under the Value Added Tax Act 2014 are voluntary VAT registration, group VAT registration, and election to zero-rate export supplies where the statutory evidentiary conditions are met. The International Companies Act also permits conversion to a domestic company, which would end the tax-exempt status, pending DCIR confirmation.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Vatu (VT) 5,000,000 annual value of taxable supplies in any 12-month period under section 8 of the Value Added Tax Act 2014
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu does not mandate real-time electronic invoicing or fiscal clearance. VAT invoices must contain the prescribed particulars set out in the VAT rules and be retained for at least 7 years. Electronic records and returns are accepted through DCIR’s digital filing platform, but there is no API-based live tax clearance, digital stamping, or continuous validation requirement.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating under the Value Added Tax Act 2014 applies to goods exported from Vanuatu and to services supplied to non-residents where the benefit is enjoyed outside Vanuatu. The supplier must hold documentary proof that the goods physically left Vanuatu within the prescribed period (ordinarily 3 months from the time of supply), and for services, that the recipient is a non-resident and the service is not consumed in Vanuatu. An International Company that entirely sells oversized furniture and home decor through online platforms to foreign customers can zero-rate those export sales, provided the statutory invoices and export evidence are maintained.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent or unsupported zero-rating claims attract a clawback of VAT at the standard rate, an additional penalty of up to 100% of the tax under-claimed, and interest from the date of the improper claim. Where the DCIR finds wilful evasion or false documentation, fines of up to VT 2,000,000 and imprisonment may be imposed under the VAT Act 2014 and the Revenue Authority Administration Act. Exporters are subject to periodic DCIR verification of customs declarations, bills of lading, and foreign remittance evidence.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) – the statutory central bank and foreign-exchange regulator under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [CAP 271]; offshore International Companies (ICs) are contractually exempt from the RBV exchange-control regime under the International Companies Act [CAP 222].
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu (VUV) is pegged to the SDR basket; current-account and capital-account convertibility are formally unrestricted for International Companies. There are no foreign-exchange licences, no capital-inflow approvals, and no restrictions on dividend, loan-interest, fee, or disposal-proceeds repatriation. The operational hurdle is convertibility liquidity: VUV has a shallow interbank market and no global clearing network, so the treasury should denominate in USD, AUD, or EUR. Profit remittance requires only a board resolution and, where requested by the clearing bank, a management or audited financial statement confirming distributable profits; Vanuatu levies zero withholding tax on outgoing remittances.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Vanuatu maintains no statutory requirement for an International Company to repatriate or surrender export proceeds. The exchange-control exemption under the International Companies Act means the entity may freely retain, convert, or transmit export earnings in any currency. No conversion ratio, statutory timeline, or mandatory surrender obligation applies to the online retail of oversized furniture and home decor; the only residual obligation is documentary reconciliation of export proceeds against customs declarations for statistical purposes.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium viability. Vanuatu is on the EU non-cooperative tax-jurisdiction blacklist, which forces EU-headquartered EMIs (Wise, Revolut, N26) to apply enhanced due diligence or reject onboarding outright. Asia-Pacific EMIs and banking-as-a-service platforms (Airwallex, Aspire, Neat) are more tolerant but require a substantive nexus, a Vanuatu licensed registered agent, and a clean UBO declaration. The prudent architecture is to maintain a domestic commercial-bank account as the mandated settlement node and use EMIs only as satellite payment corridors for supplier disbursements; merchant settlements from Stripe and Affirm must never be routed directly into EMI wallets because offshore/onboarding red flags in downstream correspondent audits can cause funds freezes.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory, with a delegated workaround. ANZ and BSP require at least one director or the authorised local registered agent to attend the Port Vila branch in person for a KYC interview and wet-signature of the customer acceptance form. Remaining directors may be onboarded remotely via notarised certified copies and a live video call. Fully remote opening without any physical touchpoint is not available to International Companies. The standard document package includes the board resolution approving the account, certificate of incorporation, register of directors and members, registered-agent certificate, and recent utility-bill proof of address for each ultimate beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore International Company with foreign UBOs flagged under low-economic-substance surveillance and OECD/EU-mandated EDD; onboarding suspended pending proof of genuine activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered-agent certificate of good standing; corporate register extracts showing paid-up capital and member identities; UBO declaration form with passport and residential address proof; business-plan and substance folder comprising a leased Port Vila office, a local director appointment, monthly operating records, and a group structure chart; evidence of ongoing e-commerce operations such as merchant platform statements and supplier contracts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: EU non-cooperative-jurisdiction blacklist status triggering automatic red flags in USD correspondent banks and heightened screening of all VUV-coded wires.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent verification that the IC is a legitimate operating e-commerce merchant, supported by Stripe and Affirm settlement reports, supplier invoices, logistics contracts, and customer-ticket data; Vanuatu tax-residency confirmation or nil-tax liability certificate issued by VFSC/Vanuatu Revenue; an institutional AML policy manual designating an internal compliance officer; a recent external audit opinion on the treasury flows.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity: bearer-share legacy or undisclosed nominee chains in historical corporate records.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete register of members and register of directors; statutory declaration confirming that no bearer shares exist post-reform; notarised consent letter from each ultimate beneficial owner; a bank reference letter from each UBO's home-jurisdiction banking institution; certified translations of any non-English corporate records.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: E-commerce payment-flow contamination: high-volume retail settlements from Stripe and Affirm BNPL flowing into the IC account appear as unrelated incoherent incoming remittances, triggering transaction-monitoring alerts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Merchant agreements and periodic settlement reports from Stripe and Affirm; a signed treasury-flow diagram mapping processor settlements into the IC account and onward supplier wires; anonymised receivables ageing report; processor-side KYC compliance letters; documented data-privacy redaction protocol for customer records.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections are routed via SWIFT MT103 from the UBO's home bank to the IC's nominated USD account at ANZ or AUD account at BSP Port Vila. Recommended SWIFT purpose codes: 'BE08 – Capital Contribution' for equity injections and 'GDDS – Intra-Group Transfer' for shareholder loans, always accompanied by a signed capital contribution or loan agreement. Because the IC is exchange-control-exempt, no RBV approval or exchange information form is required; the receiving bank's verification package includes the board resolution approving issuance, the share-registry entry, a source-of-wealth questionnaire, and a signed capital contribution agreement. To reduce clearing friction, each injection should exceed USD 50,000, use the full remitter legal entity name, and reference 'VU_IC capital injection'; personal-savings narrative descriptors must be avoided as they trigger AML review.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Settlement rails are USD and AUD denominated to avoid VUV illiquidity. Supplier payments to furniture manufacturers in Asia are executed via SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'SUPP – Payment for Imported Goods' matched against proforma invoices and packing lists; larger inventory batches use irrevocable at-sight or 60-day documentary Letters of Credit (SWIFT MT700) to mitigate shipment risk. Freight and oversized-logistics disbursements for ocean roll-on/roll-off, full-container transport, and last-mile white-glove delivery are paid via MT103 to freight-forwarder collection accounts with reference to the bill of lading. Intra-group liquidity between the Vanuatu IC and Hong Kong/Singapore distribution entities is moved via MT103 with purpose code 'INTC – Intra-Group Payments' and signed intercompany agreements retained on file. All disbursements tolerate a one-to-two-business-day clearing delay through the Port Vila correspondent corridors; a pre-funded USD working-capital buffer equal to 15 days of cost of goods sold is recommended for time-critical shipping windows.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/VUV non-deliverable forward (NDF) executed offshore – permitted because Vanuatu imposes no exchange-control approval on ICs and VUV is non-deliverable outside Vanuatu; used to lock VUV costs on local agent fees and Port Vila freight handling.
AUD/USD deliverable forward or NDF – hedges AUD operating balances at BSP when settling Australian logistics subcontractors.
EUR/USD outright forward – hedges European supplier invoices routed through EU payment aggregators.
USD/AUD cross-currency swap – manages treasury efficiency between the IC's USD settlement account and AUD-denominated local operating costs.

Plain-vanilla matched FX spot transactions – a non-derivative treasury alternative executed under the board-approved derivatives policy; speculative positions are strictly prohibited for the Vanuatu IC treasury mandate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Annual License Fee Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) via registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of VUV 10,000 (approx. USD 85) plus additional VUV 2,500 per month partial; continued non-compliance results in administrative strike-off of the International Company from the Register of International Companies.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for a standard Vanuatu International Company under the International Companies Act Cap 222. Mandatory independent audit applies only if the company holds a VFSC financial services license (e.g. banking, insurance, securities) or if shareholders/directors voluntarily resolve to have audited accounts.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory accounting framework is prescribed for International Companies; financial records may be maintained under IFRS or UK/US GAAP in practice for reporting to management and third parties.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must annually confirm the beneficial ownership information of the International Company and report material changes to the VFSC beneficial ownership register; non-compliance with UBO confirmation obligations may attract financial penalties and potential director disqualification.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Secretaries and Registered Agent

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500 - 1,500 per registered agent and office service
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required for exempt International Company; voluntary audit typically USD 2,500 - 5,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu repealed its income tax in 1987. The VU_IC is exempt from corporate income tax on worldwide offshore income under the International Companies Act 2009 (Cap. 222). No capital gains tax, branch remittance tax, withholding tax, payroll tax, or wealth tax applies to ICs. Export sales of oversized furniture and home decor are VAT zero-rated. The only annual exaction is the VFSC supervision fee (approx. VUV 12,500) plus registered-agent charges.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Return under s.95 of the International Companies Act 2009; filed electronically through the VFSC Online E-Registry portal at www.vfsc.vu
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 20 days after the anniversary of incorporation (s.95(2)); a monthly default fee accrues thereafter

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name exactly as stated on the Certificate of Incorporation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the full registered VU IC name; trade names and translated names are not accepted

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique VFSC registration number shown on the certificate
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the VU IC number only; foreign tax identifications must not be substituted

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the registered office maintained by a licensed registered agent in Port Vila or Luganville
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the agent's address; a post-office box alone is insufficient and an offshore address invalidates the filing

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationalities, residential addresses, and passport numbers of all officers
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any nationality is permissible; no Vanuatu residency requirement unless the IC asserts economic substance in Vanuatu

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Register of members, share classes, and ultimate beneficial ownership particulars required under the AML/CFT Act 2020
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose each ultimate beneficial owner; nominee shareholding must be declared separately to the registered agent

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification of compliance with the IC Act and confirmation of the absence of local taxable trading activity
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ICs must confirm zero Vanuatu-sourced sales and zero Vanuatu employees to preserve exempt status

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Statutory default fee of VUV 5,000 per month or part of a month; persistent default triggers strike-off after 12 months, restoration costs, and prohibition orders against officers

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Vanuatu Value Added Tax Return (VAT Form 1); filed monthly on the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs online filing portal; no corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before the 15th day of the month following the end of the taxable period (VAT Act 2005, s.21)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate value of all taxable supplies of oversized furniture and home decor made in Vanuatu, excluding VAT
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nil for non-resident ICs selling exclusively to foreign buyers; only in-country deliveries are reportable

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of supplies exempt under s.7A of the VAT Act
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nil unless the IC operates a physical retail outlet inside Vanuatu

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: International online sales and freight services invoiced to customers outside Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Support with bills of lading, customs export entries, overseas IP addresses, and payment routing evidence

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VAT charged on BX1 at the statutory rate of 12.5%
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Zero for offshore deliveries; charging output VAT on exports constitutes a misdeclaration penalty exposure

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Recoverable VAT on local purchases and imports used for taxable supplies
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No credit for foreign logistics costs unless expressly invoiced through a VAT-registered Vanuatu branch

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: BX6 - Net Tax Payable or Refund
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Difference between output VAT and input VAT credits remitted to the Commissioner of VAT
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Export-only ICs are entitled to refunds; repetitive artificial refund claims are a high-priority audit trigger

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late lodgment and late payment penalties ranging from 10% to 25% of the tax due, monthly statutory interest, and cancellation of VAT registration for repeat defaulters

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by an International Company to non-resident shareholders; distributions are remitted free of any deduction
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network. No treaty relief or tax residence certificate can be issued. An entity may obtain only a Certificate of Good Standing from VFSC evidencing valid incorporation and good standing. Foreign shareholders must rely on unilateral foreign tax credits, CFC exemptions, or domestic dividend participation exemptions in their residence country; the VFSC Certificate of Good Standing should be furnished to foreign tax authorities as substance evidence.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding applies to royalties and interest paid by a VU IC to non-residents; no treaty rates exist. The practical tax burden falls on the lender or licensor in its own jurisdiction. All loan and licence arrangements must be documented by signed instruments held outside Vanuatu, and excessive interest or royalties may be challenged by foreign thin-capitalisation, controlled-foreign-company, and anti-hybrid rules.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None — Vanuatu has no transfer-pricing legislation and no statutory Local File or Master File threshold in VUV. Defensive OECD-aligned transfer-pricing documentation is nevertheless advisable when the VU IC transacts with affiliates in high-tax countries and the consolidated group exceeds a foreign audit threshold such as AUD 50 million in Australia or EUR 750 million in the European Union.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Vanuatu Economic Substance Regulations, administered by the VFSC, apply to relevant entities carrying on geographically mobile relevant activities, including distribution and service-centre activity. An IC engaged in online retail of oversized furniture that claims tax residence in Vanuatu must prove: board meetings held physically in Vanuatu, a local registered office, adequate local employees and premises, and core income-generating activities directed from Vanuatu. An IC that is managed and controlled from abroad is treated as non-resident and excluded from ESR reporting, but such management-and-control abroad exposes shareholders to foreign CFC and permanent establishment recharacterisation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Directing the VU IC's entire sales force, inventory, warehousing, and day-to-day management from Australia, New Zealand, or another high-tax jurisdiction while continuing to claim Vanuatu 'tax-exempt' status without arm's-length compensation to the foreign operation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Foreign tax authorities may reattribute 100% of the e-commerce profit to the jurisdiction of effective management, with reassessment interest, penalties of 25% to 50% of the underpaid tax, and denial of input-credit or export zero-rating claims
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false certificates of offshore control face personal assessment for penalty debts, court-ordered travel bans, and criminal prosecution for tax evasion in the jurisdiction where effective control is located

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining Vanuatu registration purely as a letterbox with no local board activity, no local staff, and no local direction while representing the entity as a Vanuatu-resident company to customers or payment processors
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC warning letter, financial penalty of up to VUV 5,000,000, compulsory disclosure of all foreign activities, and deregistration of the IC from the VU registry
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil may be pierced under s.111 of the IC Act; directors and the registered agent become jointly liable for unpaid default fees, civil restitution of misappropriated profits, and disqualification from managing any VFSC-regulated company

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC to process unrelated third-party card payments through Stripe or Affirm BNPL facilities, structuring deposits in increments below AML reporting thresholds, or failing to maintain beneficial-ownership records under the AML/CFT Act 2020
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Vanuatu AML/CFT Act 2020 and the Penal Code: fines up to VUV 100,000,000, imprisonment up to 20 years on conviction, VFSC strike-off, and seizure of funds held by the registered agent
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal criminal liability, asset-freezing orders, a 10-year prohibition on acting as officers, and denial of entry or exit by court order during investigation

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to File Annual Return / Pay Annual Fee
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Missing the VFSC annual return deadline or the annual supervision fee payment for more than 12 consecutive months
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monthly default fee of VUV 5,000 compounded, followed by VFSC strike-off; the IC loses legal capacity and its assets vest in the Public Revenue
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors cannot enforce contracts on behalf of a struck-off company, become personally liable for post-strike-off trading debts, and are prohibited from acting as directors of any Vanuatu company without a court restoration order

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Making local deliveries of oversized furniture in Vanuatu above the statutory VAT registration threshold (approximately VUV 5,000,000 of annual taxable supplies) without registration, or falsely zero-rating domestic sales
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Default assessment, penalty of 25% of the tax evaded, monthly statutory interest, and criminal fines with imprisonment up to 5 years for deliberate false export declarations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The Commissioner of VAT may pierce the corporate entity where the IC is a mere facade; directors face joint liability for the VAT debt, mandatory departure prohibition orders issued by the Minister of Finance, and disqualification orders
